title: Account
name: Name
changeDetails: Ask a school admin to change your name or email.
digestHelp: One email in the early evening, only on days with something new. Class reminders are emailed separately.
recordingsText: See the recording notice, or agree to it or withdraw.
deleteSignedOut: You're signed out everywhere at once and can't sign in again.
deleteAfter: After {days} days your account and its data are deleted for good: your progress, {role, select, STUDENT {submissions, quiz answers, grades,} other {links to your children,}} notifications and agreements.
deleteCancel: Until then, a school admin can cancel it if you change your mind.
deleteRecordings: You may still appear in class recordings. Ask your school if you want one removed.
deleteStaff: Teachers and admins own courses and classes, so a school admin deletes these accounts after handing them over.
